attention_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

single_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

government_contract_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

defense_budget_same_theme_winner_gate.target_definition: official Space ticker with a mature defense_budget_theme government_space_contract row whose 10d cash-relative PnL, same-theme replacement value, and direct event return are positive

hypothesis: Within accepted dual-catalyst benchmark-breadth Space trend signals, high trade_quality_score with only moderate confidence_score may identify a catalyst/price-action setup that the generic signal confidence underweights. A bounded scalar on that disagreement bucket could improve EV without changing the candidate pool, LLM/news boundary, or live Space slots.

2_prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260512-008 accepted a broad near-perfect TQS Space trend scalar on an older stack.
exp-20260519-027 accepted the current dual-catalyst benchmark-breadth precision scalar; this run does not retune that scalar.
exp-20260520-020 rejected a short-extension signal-quality scalar because it only helped one window.
exp-20260522-019 rejected forward-consistency because current support was only one LUNR signal.
gate_answers.3_single_causal_variable: Only one extra scalar changes for benchmark-breadth Space trend signals where trade_quality_score is high but confidence_score remains below 0.90. Pool, entry, exit, ranking, LLM/news, catalyst profiles, benchmark-breadth scalar, and live slots remain fixed.
gate_answers.4_success_criteria: Because this is another Space allocation scalar, aggregate EV delta must exceed 10% of current Space aggregate EV, aggregate PnL must improve, at least two windows must improve, no window may regress, drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, survival >= 5%, trade count >= 50, fields complete, and adjusted cohort spans at least two tickers and two windows.

experiment_log_record.rejection_reason: Gate 4 failed: no confidence/TQS disagreement scalar cleared the strict 10% EV, multi-window, no-regression, cohort breadth, drawdown, survival, and trade-count acceptance gates.
experiment_log_record.next_evidence_needed: Do not retry this confidence/TQS disagreement scalar on the frozen Space sample. Next Space alpha should move toward capped activation or displacement evidence after more closed forward observations.

production_impact.notes: Experiment-only wrapper; no live policy promoted.

experiment_log_record.why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking is still underpowered; Space pool pruning and VSAT satcom additions were rejected; short-extension and forward consistency were recently rejected. This uses an existing production-visible signal-quality interaction instead.
